outputs.name: Apollo Studio Phase 2 - product model and catalog repair
outputs.summary: Repaired stale Knowledge discovery and defined the Phase 2 product model plus three approval-gated IA directions.
outputs.content:
# Apollo Studio Phase 2

Status: product model and information architecture complete; IA selection required before Phase 3.

Defect repair:
- Before: the running server exposed 19 skills.
- Root cause: the Node process started at 14:27 and retained the old module, while skills.mjs changed at 14:58.
- Fix: npm start now uses Node watch mode; start:once preserves a fixed-process option; health reports loaded and enabled skill counts; the stale server was restarted.
- After: health and Knowledge expose 22 skills, including the three requested capabilities.

Phase 2 artifact:
- Canonical entities and ownership rules for Project, Style Profile, Reference Decision, Mission, Squad Configuration, Agent Definition, Agent Configuration, Run, Artifact, Portfolio Entry, Playbook, and Progress Record.
- Snapshot/versioning, evidence-state, token-usage, and attribution rules.
- Progressive disclosure and lifecycle.
- Three IA directions: A Oracle-first journey (recommended), B Studio desk, C Mission map.
- No broader navigation or UI build was implemented.

Validation:
- npm.cmd run check passed.
- Desktop Knowledge shows 22 skills and all three new entries.
- 390x844 mobile shows 22 with no document overflow.
- Browser console warnings/errors: none.
- Evidence screenshots saved under apollo-studio/evidence.
- Exact host token usage unavailable; no number estimated or recorded.

Decision required: approve A, B, or C before Phase 3 flows and content begin.

outputs.content:
# Apollo Studio design-system foundation

Status: Phase 1 foundation complete. No broader UI/product work was performed; all later phases require approval.

Created and registered: taste-first-experience-design, ethical-gamification-systems, agent-identity-and-portfolio.

Skill routing: skill-creator was invoked. apple-design, prototype, emil-design-eng, customer-research, onboarding, image, animate, analytics, and ab-testing are conditional recommendations only and were not invoked.

Stages: inspect conventions; initialize and author skills; register and initialize Apollo knowledge; validate; record run; stop.

Token observability: exact Codex-hosted whole-run usage is unavailable. This run did not use Apollo's Responses adapter and the host exposed no trustworthy count. No number is recorded, and zero is not substituted. Existing Apollo events accept actual phase tokens and the UI renders absence as "Tokens not reported"; no new instrumentation was needed.

Validation: npm.cmd run check passed; Apollo discovered all three capabilities; local structure passed a dependency-free quick_validate.py equivalent; the official validator could not run because bundled Python lacks PyYAML; no package was installed; all three Apollo knowledge README entries exist.

Manual validation:
1. Start Apollo Studio and open Knowledge. Find each exact ID. Screenshot all three cards (or one per skill). Assess distinct ownership and legible descriptions.
2. Open Runs > apollo-studio-foundation-20260811-codex. Screenshot the header and phase rows. Confirm "Tokens not reported", never "0 tokens".
3. Open Output library > Apollo Studio design-system foundation. Screenshot status and run ID. Confirm foundation-only completion.
Also assess whether Oracle language is nontechnical, spend/status safeguards feel protective, agent identities keep proof and limitations visible, and absent usage never looks exact.

Approval-gated follow-on plan:
Phase 2 product model/information architecture.
Phase 3 critical UX flows and Oracle content.
Phase 4 visual identity and prototype.
Phase 5 approved bounded implementation.
Phase 6 browser, accessibility, analytics, and experiment validation.
Do not begin Phase 2 without user approval.
